props.gloss_en: the mishna: the sanctity of Jerusalem -- there is no permission after it (out-of-span, rule 13; also in megillah_9b_shilo_yerushalayim)
Zevachim's mishna: once they came to Jerusalem the bamot were forbidden and there was never again permission for them; and it was 'the inheritance'
R' Yitzchak: I heard that one sacrifices in Beit Chonyo at the present time
he holds: Beit Chonyo is not a house of idolatry
the first sanctification sanctified for its time and did not sanctify for the future
'the rest' (Deut 12:9) -- this is Shiloh
'the inheritance' (Deut 12:9) -- this is Jerusalem

R' Eliezer: I heard that when they were building the Sanctuary they made hangings for the Sanctuary and hangings for the courtyard; but for the Sanctuary they built from outside, and for the courtyard from inside
R' Yehoshua: I heard that one sacrifices even though there is no House
...one eats most-sacred offerings even though there are no hangings
...lesser offerings and second tithe even though there is no wall
the first sanctification sanctified for its time and sanctified for the future
stam: by implication, R' Eliezer holds it did not sanctify for the future
R' Yishmael b. R' Yosei: why did the Sages count these? because when the exiles came up they found these and consecrated them; but the first ones were voided when the land was voided
stam: evidently [R' Yishmael b. R' Yosei] holds the first sanctification did not sanctify for the future
R' Yishmael b. R' Yosei: were these alone [walled]? -- they were not the only ones
it is already said 'sixty cities, all the region of Argov' and 'all these were cities fortified with a high wall' (Deut 3:4-5)
rather, why did the Sages count these? because the exiles found these and consecrated them
stam: rather [read]: they found these and counted them
and not these alone: any [city] of which you have a tradition from your fathers that it was walled since the days of Joshua son of Nun -- all these mitzvot apply in it
R' Elazar b. R' Yosei: 'which has [lo] a wall' (Lev 25:30) -- even though it has none now, if it had one before

schemas.gloss_en: כי לא באתם עד עתה אל המנוחה ואל הנחלה (Deut 12:9) -- rest is Shiloh, inheritance is Jerusalem; the verse juxtaposes inheritance to rest: as after 'rest' there is permission, so after 'inheritance' there is permission

supports.gloss_en: מפני שקדושה ראשונה קידשה לשעתה וקידשה לעתיד לבוא -- R' Yehoshua's own ground for his three rulings
אלא כי הני תנאי, דתניא: ... אבל הראשונות בטלו משבטלה הארץ -- אלמא קסבר לא קידשה לעתיד לבוא
והלא כבר נאמר: ששים עיר כל חבל ארגב... כל אלה ערים בצרות חומה גבהה (Deut 3:4-5) -- there were many walled cities
דתניא: רבי אלעזר ברבי יוסי אמר: אשר לוא חומה -- אף על פי שאין לו עכשיו והיה לו קודם לכן: R' Elazar b. R' Yosei holds the earlier walling still counts
